input.summary: Add express IP-infringement, breach-of-law, data-breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct triggers to Harpoon's indemnity in 11.2, and confine AbbVie's 11.1 indemnity to AbbVie-provided materials and AbbVie's breach of Applicable Law.
input.comment: [Playbook] Because the trigger lists in 11.1 and 11.2 are redacted, we add the scope our playbook requires as additions to the existing lists: Harpoon must indemnify and defend us for Third Party Claims alleging infringement or misappropriation of Third Party IP by the Licensed Compounds, Licensed Products, Harpoon Patents or Harpoon Know-How, and for Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law, Harpoon-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of our Confidential Information or data, and Harpoon's gross negligence or willful misconduct. We also cap our own indemnity at AbbVie-provided materials and our breach of Applicable Law. The existing notice, control-of-defense and cooperation mechanics in 11.3 and 11.4 are untouched and continue to apply.

ops.text: AbbVie's indemnification and defense obligations under this Section 11.1 are limited to Third Party Claims arising from or occurring as a result of (a) materials, Information or content provided by AbbVie or its Affiliates hereunder and (b) AbbVie's breach of Applicable Law.

Without limiting the foregoing, the Third Party Claims for which Harpoon shall indemnify and defend the AbbVie Indemnitees under this Section 11.2 include those arising from or occurring as a result of: (a) any allegation that the Licensed Compounds, Licensed Products, Harpoon Patents or Harpoon Know-How infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a Third Party; (b) Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of AbbVie's Confidential Information or data caused by Harpoon; and (d) Harpoon's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
